newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Petkim to tender for chemicals.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Petkim to tender for chemicals.

text.p: Turkey's petrochemicals producer Petkim will import several chemicals through tenders it will hold later this month and in December, the Official Gazette said on Tuesday.
It will receive bids for 51,000 tonnes of ethylenedichloride, 35,200 tonnes of ethylene and 24,000 styrinen monomer by November 29, the gazette said.
It said the company would collect bids to import 216,000 tonnes of fuel-oil additives and 20,000 tonnes of hydroquinone phote grade by December 11.
